claims: Artemis I completed in November 2022.
Artemis I was an uncrewed flight test of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis I was an uncrewed flight test of the Orion capsule.
Artemis I orbited the Moon to verify systems.
Artemis II launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of the Artemis program.
Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen are the Artemis II crew.
The Artemis II crew is conducting a 10-day flyby.
Artemis II is testing life support.
Artemis II is breaking crewed distance records.
Artemis III is targeted for mid-2027.
Artemis III is planned to be the first mission to land astronauts on the lunar South Pole.
Artemis III is planned to utilize SpaceX Starship as a commercial lander.
Artemis IV is targeted for early 2028.
Artemis IV is planned to deliver crew to the lunar surface.
Artemis IV is planned to begin assembly of the Gateway lunar space station.
Artemis V is targeted for late 2020s.
The Artemis program uses the SLS rocket.
The SLS rocket is 15% more powerful than the Apollo-era Saturn V.
The Artemis program uses the Orion spacecraft to transport crews.
